name: badger-maps-standard
description: Manage field sales accounts, routes, check-ins, and follow-ups with Badger Maps.

interface.longDescription:
Badger Maps is a field sales platform.

Badger Maps gives field sales teams tools to work with customer accounts, routes, check-ins, and follow-ups. Use the features that fit your workflow to manage customer information and field activity.

Route Planning: Work with routes and accounts
Find accounts in an area, review account details, and view or manage routes in Badger Maps.

Follow-Ups: Review follow-up details
View future and overdue follow-ups and update customer account records in Badger Maps.

Field Visits: Record customer check-ins
Create and update check-ins associated with customer visits.

Field sales involves route planning, account management, and follow-up activity.
Use Badger Maps to view and manage these details in one place.

Badger Maps provides tools for field sales teams.
defaultPrompt: Find accounts near my current area.
Help me plan a route for these accounts.
